title: Rethinking Text-to-SQL: Dynamic Multi-turn SQL Interaction for Real-world Database Exploration
authors_zh: Linzhuang Sun, Tianyu Guo, Hao Liang, Ruitong Liu, Yuying Li, Qifeng Cai, Jingxuan Wei, Yuchen Wu, Bihui Yu, Xiangxiang Zhang, Wentao Zhang, Bin Cui
paper_type_zh: 可执行的多轮 Text-to-SQL 交互基准
best_for_zh: 研究数据库代理、多轮 SQL 交互或执行式奖励的研究者。
one_line: DySQL-Bench evaluates multi-turn SQL agents by executing their CRUD actions on database snapshots and checking both query results and state changes.
DySQL-Bench 在数据库快照中执行多轮 SQL 的 CRUD 操作，并同时检查查询结果和状态变化来评估代理。
why: It moves Text-to-SQL evaluation from static query matching to stateful, executable database interaction.
inclusion_reason: DySQL-Bench supplies executable multi-turn SQL trajectories whose query results and state changes provide programmatic outcome labels.

title: Problem
问题
html: Static Text-to-SQL assumes a complete one-turn question and usually generates only SELECT queries, whereas real analysis iteratively changes filters, aggregations, and even performs INSERT, UPDATE, or DELETE based on intermediate results. Existing benchmarks therefore cannot test whether database agents preserve state and modify data correctly across turns. The paper introduces DySQL-Bench and a three-party environment where a simulated user changes intent, the model executes SQL each turn, and a real database verifies results and state.
静态 Text-to-SQL 假设用户一次给出完整问题，只生成 SELECT；真实分析却会根据中间结果连续修改筛选、聚合甚至执行 INSERT、UPDATE、DELETE。现有 benchmark 因此无法评估数据库 agent 是否保持跨轮状态和正确修改数据。论文构建 DySQL-Bench 与三方交互环境，让模拟用户动态改变意图，模型每轮执行 SQL，并由真实数据库状态和查询结果验证。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: DySQL-Bench contains 1,072 tasks across 13 domains from BIRD and Spider 2 databases. The pipeline first converts schemas and table content into hierarchical logic trees, then uses an LLM to synthesize multi-turn user–database interactions. Automated verify-and-refine executes every SQL statement and checks state differences and semantics, followed by expert confirmation; the paper reports 100% data correctness. Records include databases, initial states, turn intents, SQL, execution results, and terminal oracles for multi-turn agent evaluation and execution rewards.

DySQL-Bench 含 1,072 个任务，覆盖 BIRD 与 Spider 2 数据库的 13 个领域。构建流程先把原始 schema 和表内容转成层级逻辑树，再由 LLM 合成多轮用户—数据库交互；自动 verify-and-refine 执行每条 SQL、检查状态差异与语义一致性，最终由专家确认，论文报告样本正确率 100%。记录包括数据库、初始状态、轮次意图、SQL、执行结果和终局 oracle，可用于多轮 agent 评测与执行奖励。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Build logic trees: Extract entities, operations, and constraints from schemas, foreign keys, and table values to represent compositional user intents.
  1. Synthesize multi-turn tasks: An LLM follows the tree to generate evolving requests covering queries and data manipulation.
  1. Execute, verify, and refine: Run SQL in isolated databases and compare expected results or state; failing records are revised or removed.
  1. Expert confirmation and evaluation: Humans audit final trajectories, and a simulated user–agent–database environment computes turn accuracy, overall accuracy, and strict Pass^5. Reproduction must freeze database snapshots, transaction isolation, and user simulators.

1. 建立逻辑树： 从 schema、外键和表值抽取实体、操作与约束，表示可组合用户意图。
  1. 合成多轮任务： LLM 沿树生成逐轮变化的请求，覆盖查询与数据操作。
  1. 执行验证和修订： 在隔离数据库运行 SQL，比较预期结果/状态；失败样本自动修订或删除。
  1. 专家确认与评测： 人工核查最终轨迹，在模拟用户—agent—数据库环境计算 turn accuracy、overall accuracy 与严格 Pass^5。复现需冻结数据库快照、事务隔离和用户模拟器。

title: Evidence
证据
html: On 1,072 tasks, GPT-4o reaches only 58.34% overall accuracy, and strict Pass^5—requiring five consecutive correct turns—is just 23.81%. Error analysis shows greater difficulty with changing intent, write operations, and cross-turn dependencies than with static SELECT. Human review reports 100% correctness of synthesized data, suggesting low scores reflect task difficulty rather than noisy labels. The conclusion still depends on simulated users and selected databases and does not cover every enterprise workflow.
在 1,072 个任务上，即使 GPT-4o 的 overall accuracy 也只有 58.34%，严格要求连续五轮均正确的 Pass^5 仅 23.81%。错误分析显示模型在意图变化、写操作和跨轮依赖上明显弱于静态 SELECT。人工复核确认合成数据正确率为 100%，说明低分更可能来自任务能力而非脏标签。该结论仍依赖模拟用户和指定数据库，不能代表所有企业工作流。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier multi-turn Text-to-SQL mostly refines queries while leaving database state unchanged, allowing per-query matching. DySQL-Bench makes both user intent and database state evolve and scores by actual results and post-transaction state differences; logic trees enable scalable synthesis. The innovation lies in interaction and oracles, not a new SQL decoder.
此前多轮 Text-to-SQL 多是连续改写查询，但数据库状态基本不变，评测仍可逐条匹配 SQL。DySQL-Bench 的新意是让用户意图和数据库状态都随执行变化，并通过事务后的真实结果与 state diff 判分；逻辑树又使任务能够自动扩展。改变的是交互和 oracle，而不是提出新的 SQL decoder。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Simulated-user bias: Users are LLM-generated, while real analysts may express ambiguity, corrections, and preferences differently.
  1. Execution risk: Write operations must run on isolated snapshots and should never be connected to production databases.
  1. Database coverage: Thirteen domains remain relational and omit permissions, concurrency, stored procedures, and cross-database transactions. Strict Pass^5 also depends on trajectory length, which must be controlled in comparisons.

1. 模拟用户偏差： 用户由 LLM 生成，真实分析人员的模糊表达、纠错和偏好可能不同。
  1. 执行风险： 写操作必须在隔离快照中运行；任何复用都不能连接生产数据库。
  1. 数据库覆盖： 13 个领域仍以结构化关系库为主，缺少权限、并发、存储过程和跨库事务。严格 Pass^5 也受轨迹长度影响，比较时需控制轮数。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Evaluate multi-turn SQL agents: Run full interactions on database snapshots and report per-turn, terminal, and Pass^k metrics.
  1. Train trajectories: Use intents, SQL, execution results, and next-turn feedback for SFT or agent RL.
  1. Execution verifier: Reward query results and state differences while separating syntax, runtime, and semantic errors. DySQL-Bench may be excessive for static queries, and sensitive data requires sanitized copies and permission sandboxes.

1. 多轮 SQL agent 评测： 在快照数据库中运行完整交互，报告逐轮、终局和 Pass^k。
  1. 轨迹训练： 将意图、SQL、执行结果和下一轮用户反馈用于 SFT 或 agent RL。
  1. 执行 verifier： 以 query result 与 state diff 作为奖励，分离语法、运行和语义错误。若任务只需静态查询，DySQL-Bench 可能过重；若涉及真实敏感数据，必须使用脱敏副本与权限沙箱。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence position: DySQL-Bench evaluates agents on 1,072 dynamic tasks where database state changes across SQL turns.
  2. Method takeaway: Schema logic trees, interaction synthesis, SQL execution, state diffs, and expert validation.
  3. Data takeaway: Thirteen domains record every intent, SQL statement, result, and terminal state.
  4. Evidence anchor: GPT-4o reaches 58.34% overall and 23.81% Pass^5.
  5. Reuse decision: It fits multi-turn database agents, with all writes restricted to isolated snapshots.

1. 一句话定位： DySQL-Bench 用 1,072 个动态任务评估数据库状态随多轮 SQL 改变的 agent。
  2. 方法抓手： schema 逻辑树、交互合成、SQL 执行、state diff 与专家确认。
  3. 数据抓手： 覆盖 13 领域，记录每轮意图、SQL、结果与终局状态。
  4. 证据锚点： GPT-4o overall 58.34%，Pass^5 23.81%。
  5. 复用决定： 适合多轮数据库代理；所有写操作必须在隔离快照。
